usedFor: Aircall holds your phone contacts, and Slack is where the team sees them through “Send Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in Aircall, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: Each new phone contact lands in a channel, so the team sees who just came in.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for your approval today, so “Send Message” will not post alone.
